name: Yushima
tagline: Otemachi in 6 minutes and Tokyo in 12 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Taito City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 6 minutes to Otemachi, 18 minutes to Shinjuku, 28 minutes to Shibuya and 26 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 5.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 17.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 5.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 3.5 m to 21.1 m, a difference of 17.6 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 54 clinics and 45 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 東都文京病院, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 萩原医院, about 9 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line runs at 150% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 町屋→西日暮里, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000. 1LDK ¥220,000 to ¥230,000 and 2LDK ¥280,000 to ¥290,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is on the high side. plenty of places to eat out pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For One room, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Okachimachi, but Yushima is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Yushima. Okachimachi has 5 lines that Yushima does not. With more lines, Okachimachi is the better connected of the two. To Otemachi, for instance, Okachimachi takes 7 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥28,000 less at Okachimachi. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, though, Yushima comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Keisei-Ueno, but Yushima is ahead on how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Yushima. Keisei-Ueno also has the Keisei Main Line and Narita Sky Access Line, which Yushima does not. With more lines, Keisei-Ueno is the better connected of the two. To Otemachi, for instance, Keisei-Ueno takes 22 minutes longer. A one-room flat also costs about ¥49,000 less at Keisei-Ueno.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: 昌平橋通り (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 25 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Chiyoda Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
